items: [Personalized Initial Design Fanny Pack] Make your belt bag stand out with a stylish and minimalist design with a variety of initial collages. Personalised letter patches are a popular way to decorate your fashion.

items.label: [Product Features] Dimensions
items.value: 19.8cm x 6cm x 12.7cm (7.8" x 2.4" x 5"). Strap length 71cm (28") - 111cm (44"). The Gitus Initial Patch fanny pack is made from a skin friendly clothing material (nylon). It is lightweight (0.15kg), easy-care and water-resistant. The zipper is strong and smooth. It won't stick after repeated use, which is a guarantee for long term use.

items.label: [Keep your stuff organised]
items.value: To keep your daily essentials organised and everything you need close at hand, the everywhere belt bag has two zipped pockets and three mesh compartment. It can hold your mobile phone, wallet, keys, passport, lipstick, hand sanitiser, sunglasses and other small items. It offers you great convenience.

items: [Everywhere belt bag] Belt bag has an adjustable strap and a durable buckle that can be adjusted to any length you need. It can be used as a cross-body bag, as a belt bag or as a chest bag. It is perfect for cycling, running, walking, camping, hiking, travelling and more.

[Cute stuff for her] Letter patches make each waist bag more fashionable and suitable for different scenes or festivals. It is an ideal trendy gifts for Birthday, Thanksgiving, Christmas, New Year, Easter, Wedding Party, Valentine's Day and other days. Trendy girly gifts stuff for teen girls, friends, daughters, mothers and sisters.
